extraction_notes: Datasheet type designation is 'BSS 83 P'; H6327 in the target MPN is the PG-SOT-23 tape-and-reel ordering suffix (3000 pcs/reel) listed in the p. 1 ordering table, so the target identity BSS83PH6327 is confirmed.

P-channel device: all datasheet voltages and currents are negative. Per the mosfet context pack, every value and curve point in this file is recorded as a magnitude; axis quantity strings and conditions note the original negative sign convention.
SI units used throughout: capacitances in farads (datasheet pF values scaled by 1e-12), resistances in ohms, currents in amperes, voltages in volts.

Curves were digitized visually from 400 dpi renders of pages 6 and 7 (vector figures, no embedded data). Linear plots were read against 0.05 A / 0.5 V gridlines; estimated read precision about 0.01-0.02 A and 0.05-0.1 V. Log capacitance plot read against decade and minor gridlines; estimated precision about 10-15 percent.

Internal consistency checks pass: transfer-curve currents at |VGS| = 2.5/3.0/3.5 V (0.09/0.285/0.52 A) match the output-curve saturation plateaus (0.093/0.277/0.53 A), and the transfer-curve slope near |ID| = 0.27 A is about 0.46 S versus the tabulated gfs typ 0.47 S.

Discrepancy noted in the datasheet itself: the Ciss trace on the p. 7 capacitance figure reads about 49-50 pF at |VDS| = 25 V while the p. 3 table gives Ciss typ = 62 pF at the same condition. The Crss trace (about 7.1 pF at 25 V) and Coss trace (about 16.6 pF at 25 V) agree with or sit close to their table values (7 pF, 19 pF). Both sources are reported: table values in specs, figure reads in curves.

Output curve d (VGS = -4.0 V) exits the plotted ID range near |VDS| = 1.3 V before saturating; only its triode segment is recorded. Curves e through l (VGS = -4.5 to -10 V) are bunched into an unresolvable cluster in the triode region and were not digitized; their on-resistance behaviour is covered by the tabulated RDS(on) rows and the p. 6 RDS(on) = f(ID) figure.

Additional tabulated evidence not representable in the specs object: gfs min 0.24 S / typ 0.47 S at ID = -0.27 A (p. 3); IDSS typ -0.1 uA / max -1 uA at VDS = -60 V, Tj = 25 degC (p. 2); IGSS max -100 nA at VGS = -20 V (p. 2); Qgs typ 1.2e-10 C, Qgd typ 1.1e-9 C, Qg typ 2.38e-9 C at VDD = -48 V, ID = -0.33 A, VGS = 0 to -10 V, V(plateau) typ -2.94 V (p. 4); trr typ 5.94e-8 s, Qrr typ 3.75e-8 C at VR = -30 V, IF = IS, diF/dt = 80 A/us (p. 4); RthJA max 350 K/W (min footprint) / 300 K/W (6 cm2), RthJS max 150 K/W (p. 2).
Only the public Infineon datasheet was used as evidence; no vendor SPICE or model packs were consulted.
